cases.question: Toplam kaç sipariş var?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

cases.question: Toplam kaç müşteri kaydı var?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers;

cases.question: Toplam kaç ürün var?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products;

cases.question: Teslim edilmiş kaç sipariş var?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

cases.question: İptal edilmiş kaç sipariş var?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

cases.question: Siparişlerin durumlarına göre dağılımı nedir?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status;

cases.question: Müşterilerin eyaletlere göre dağılımı nedir?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_state;

cases.question: Ödeme kayıtlarındaki toplam ödeme tutarı nedir?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM order_payments;

cases.question: Ödeme kayıtlarının ortalama tutarı nedir?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(payment_value) AS average_payment_value FROM order_payments;

cases.question: São Paulo eyaletindeki müşterilerin verdiği toplam sipariş sayısı kaçtır?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP';

cases.question: 2018 yılında kaç sipariş verilmiş?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';

cases.question: Her eyaletteki müşterilerin verdiği sipariş sayısını göster.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state;
